entity.name: Antonio Leandro
entity.description: Software engineer in Recife, Brazil. Author and sole maintainer of OmniGet.

projects.name: OmniGet
projects.description: A free, open source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux whose main part is a local MCP server: it gives coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor a toolbox for downloads, media, files, the person's chats and the computer itself. Each tool connects with its own token after the person clicks Allow, and anything that posts, sends or cleans waits for their approval. It is also a downloader: paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Twitch or one of the sites yt-dlp supports and get the file. Its Canvas runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and local models side by side in terminals, and its System Cleaner shows a plan and asks before it changes anything. No account, no telemetry on what anyone downloads. Everything runs on the person's machine.

plans.name: A year of maintenance
plans.description: What it costs to keep OmniGet alive for twelve months: builds and code signing across three platforms, plus the constant repair of extractors as the sites they read change underneath them. One person does all of it.
